title: Dental care in Mohandessin
description: Explore dental care in Mohandessin for toothache, cleaning, missing teeth and smile concerns. Compare options and book an assessment at {{brand}}.
answer: {{brand}} in Mohandessin provides dental assessment for tooth pain, damaged or missing teeth and concerns about a smile. Care can include cleaning, whitening, fillings, crowns, root treatment, implants or veneers. An examination of the teeth, gums and bite helps decide what needs attention first and which options to consider.
preparation: We examine your teeth and gums, discuss your concerns and check for underlying problems.
howPerformed: Our Mohandessin branch offers cleaning, whitening, cosmetic bonding, smile design and porcelain veneers. Tell us what concerns you about your teeth so we can discuss the most suitable options.
followup: You can usually return to your routine after cleaning, whitening or bonding. Temporary sensitivity may occur, particularly after whitening. More involved work may need several visits, with care instructions at each stage.
suitability: You can book an assessment for concerns about tooth colour, chips, gaps or the appearance of your smile. We will check your oral health and discuss whether cosmetic treatment is appropriate.
outlook: Results depend on the procedure. Whitening can change tooth colour, while bonding or veneers can change shape and appearance. We will explain the likely result and how to maintain it.

faqs.q: Is whitening safe for my teeth?
faqs.a: Whitening needs a dental assessment first. We check your teeth and gums, explain the product and concentration, and discuss possible sensitivity or gum irritation. It does not change the colour of existing fillings or crowns.

It is a term for a plan to improve the colour and shape of the teeth visible when you smile, often using veneers. We discuss the shade, shape and amount of change you want before choosing an approach.

faqs.q: Do you treat dental problems too?
faqs.a: We assess your dental health first and explain which problems need attention before cosmetic treatment. Ask our team about the care available at the Mohandessin branch.
Tell the team about dental sensitivity. The examination helps decide whether local anaesthesia or other comfort measures are appropriate.

faqs.q: How many visits might I need?
faqs.a: The number of visits depends on the stages needed and healing between them.

faqs.q: Can I go back to my usual routine afterwards?
faqs.a: You can usually return to your routine after cleaning, whitening or bonding. Temporary sensitivity may occur, particularly after whitening. More involved work may need several visits, with care instructions at each stage.

faqs.q: Can I have treatment with sensitive teeth or gums?
faqs.a: Sensitivity can come from decay, exposed roots or gum problems. The oral assessment identifies what needs care before a procedure.
Yes. The assessment is individual and takes account of your oral health, bite and existing restorations.
